entries.title: Ruff rejects mutable default argument
entries.root_cause: The collect_spools function uses an empty list as its default argument, violating Ruff rule B006. Replace the mutable default with None and initialize the list inside the function.

entries.title: Package registry cannot be resolved
entries.root_cause: The configured Python package index host cannot be resolved by the runner, preventing dependency installation. Restore DNS resolution for the configured index.
